title: D3D12 Crashes due to SPIR-V parsing error only on specific laptop
body:
### Tested versions

I tried 4.3, 4.5 stable and master branch

### System information

Windows 10 - AMD Ryzen 7 5800H with Radeon Graphics - NVIDIA GeForce RTX3060 Laptop GPU

### Issue description

When running a project / exported game with d3d12 enabled, it will crash with following errors:
```
Unicode parsing error, some characters were replaced with ? (U+FFFD): Unexpected NUL character
Unicode parsing error, some characters were replaced with ? (U+FFFD): Unexpected NUL character

ERROR:ERROR:ERROR:ERROR:ERROR:ERROR: Serialization of root signature failed with error 0x80070057 and the following message:
Unsupported bit-flag set (root signature flags 33e).
?

 Failed to compile code to native for SPIR-V.
   at: (drivers\d3d12\rendering_shader_container_d3d12.cpp:803)
ERROR: Failed to compile code to native for SPIR-V.
   at: (servers\rendering\rendering_device.cpp:3461)
ERROR:ERROR:ERROR: Failed to compile code to native for SPIR-V.
```

What I have tried:

- Make sure the project, game and my windows user path in pure English
- Make sure the display mode is NVIDIA GPU only
- Switched the system locale to en
- Disabled or enabled Beta: Use Unicode UTF-8 for worldwide language support
- Switched to latest Studio Driver (my previous test was using Game Ready Driver)
- Disabled all non windows service

but the issue still remains.

You may check the detailed errorlog below
[error.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/24426161/error.txt)

### Steps to reproduce

Any project / exported game with d3d12 enabled will crash in my laptop.
This one is really weird, it seems to happen only in my laptop.
